# Tabs

```tsx
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Serve para organizar o conteúdo em seções e permitir a navegação entre elas.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<Tabs
  {...args}
  onValueChange={(value, details) => {
    updateArgs({ value })
    args.onValueChange?.(value, details)
  }}
>
  <TabsList level={level}>
    {tabs.map((tab) => (
      <TabsTrigger
        key={tab.value}
        value={tab.value}
        icon={showIcon ? CommandIcon : undefined}
        badge={showBadge ? 1 : undefined}
      >
        {tab.label}
      </TabsTrigger>
    ))}
  </TabsList>
  {tabs.map((tab) => (
    <TabsContent key={tab.value} value={tab.value}>
      {tab.content}
    </TabsContent>
  ))}
</Tabs>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Tabs component: Level (Primary / Secondary) × Count, with the .Tab Primary and .Tab Secondary partials as triggers: State (Default / Hover / Disabled) × Active, plus Show Icon and Show Badge.
- Primary: 48px tabs on a Border/Primary bottom line; the active one turns Text/Accent/Standard with a 4px Background/Accent/Strong ribbon.
- Secondary: 40px pills 8px apart; the active one gets Background/Accent/Soft and Text/Accent/Standard. Hover paints Background/Hover on inactive tabs. Count is simply the number of TabsTrigger children.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`TabsList`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `level?` | `TabsLevel` | Figma "Level". |

`TabsTrigger`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon?` | `IconSvgElement` | Figma "Show Icon": a Hugeicons icon before the label. |
| `badge?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Show Badge": a count after the label. |

## Types

`TabsLevel`

## Rules

- Import `Tabs` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
